source_timing: Auxiliary sources support bounded local diagnostics because their coverage differs from the national prediction inputs. source record SRC-S64 records their roles and measurement dates. The 88 surface-weather CSV files cover the eight targets over eleven years [40]. Embedded METAR timestamps support UTC interpretation. Incident clocks are converted from airport local time, with ambiguous or nonexistent daylight-saving times excluded. Each weather variable is matched separately to the latest nonmissing observation within the preceding 60 minutes. Conflicting station-time values are excluded where a unique measurement is unavailable. This rule preserves recent temperature information when a later record contains wind alone. Matched precipitation is the reported surface-record accumulation; trace and nonnumeric values remain missing. The separate 88 hourly precipitation spreadsheets have unresolved timezone provenance and incomplete year boundaries. Their values remain outside incident matching. FD files describe forecasts with reference times, valid times and altitude levels [41]. They remain separate from observed surface weather. Wetland polygons and project footprints have mixed source dates and classification definitions [42]. The 2025 land-cover confidence index describes classifier confidence. Summaries use pixels with values 1–100. Other codes remain outside these averages; valid-pixel coverage uses all buffer pixels as its denominator. All thirteen Sentinel acquisitions date from 2026, after the outcome window. Airport vectors and runway geometries supply spatial context. TFMSC contains DEN-only monthly classifications, subtotals and a grand total. Detail rows describe activity categories. Its coverage supplies no common eight-airport movement denominator. These source distinctions determine which measurements can support the stated retrospective report analysis.
source_interpretation: Local weather summaries use frozen probabilities and describe residual associations. Wetland, confidence and geometry audits provide measurement context. They supply neither national exposure coverage nor independent ecological validation. Their complete diagnostic tables remain traceable to source records, while the primary conditional-damage predictions use the nationally consistent input set defined in S1.
execution_and_replay_inventory: A measured ordinary-reference run completed 26 fits, calibration, prediction and output writing in 7.31 seconds. source record SRC-S65 records the host, numerical environment and resource counters. The run used one worker and one thread per numerical library on a Windows 11 host with 24 logical processors. Wall time includes imports and input loading. The operating-system peak working set was 854.1 MB. Sampling every 0.05 seconds gave a peak resident working set of 828.6 MB and a final sampled CPU total of 5.25 seconds. This task excludes raster extraction, complex-model development, resampling and human work. An initial monitoring setup failure occurred before fitting; the execution records retain that failure and subsequent use of Windows counters. A separate-directory replay matched 63,227 baseline predictions with maximum absolute difference zero. Alignment used evaluation scheme, dataset, fold and event identifier. The replay reused the same host and numerical environment and was separate from the timed execution. A relocated replay reconstructed the 52,103-report cohort, including all 303 fields and their data types. It repeated 48 national configurations with 768 internal and final fits. Both raw and calibrated probabilities matched across 505,816 prediction rows. Selection, encoding and calibration also matched. Profile replay rebuilt conditional count limits for all 1,375 national airports under five references. The full-data model reproduced conditional effects and rank intervals for 1,383 airports. Enhanced-event replay matched eight configurations, 136,480 prediction rows and four paired landscape contrasts. Landscape summaries and predictor tables also matched the retained values. The archived figure replay reproduced its six main and twelve supplementary figures at 600 dpi. Environmental replay reconstructed the same-year and previous-year airport panels. Sensitivity replay matched 32 configurations and 511,564 prediction rows. Eight static-canopy configurations also reproduced 136,480 prediction rows. Landscape development replay repeated all 200 attempts, including both failures. Surface-weather replay reproduced all 5,936 target records and their strata. Spatial replay reproduced wetland areas, source vintages and runway summaries. Source audits reconstructed confidence summaries, acquisition dates, forecasts and precipitation coverage. Nine descriptive context tables were reconstructed from events, environments and frozen predictions. Raw-raster replay also matched all eight targets and DEN's alternative reference. Figure counts and review-example values were computed from their inputs. Aggregate verification instead uses airport summaries, paired losses and joint draws to reconstruct displayed comparisons. Development replay requires the retained event-field projection and environmental inputs. Repeating source-workbook screening requires the exact FAA snapshot and lookup information. File checksums distinguish these inputs from later downloads covering the same years. The saved evidence map links each table to its numerical source and calculation scope.
aggregate_replay_and_AI_role: A separate-directory aggregate replay reproduced pooled estimates, simultaneous comparisons and national summaries from saved inputs.
